environment.description: IoT gRPC gateway deployed on ECS Fargate behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with direct TCP passthrough on port 50051. No TLS termination at the load balancer level. Devices connect directly to the gRPC endpoint. Backend service on port 50052 trusts all metadata headers from the gateway for authorization decisions including x-admin-override and x-auth-level. No metadata filtering or sanitization at any network layer.
